te: Minutes of Meeting No. 36 approved, subcommittee work, and complaints from the public
se: The next meeting is on Wednesday 18 November 2026 at 13.00 hrs, room CA 426. According to the meeting notice, the agenda includes approving the minutes of Meeting No. 36/2569, considering the work of the subcommittees, matters referred by the President of the Senate or other committees, including complaints from the public, and matters within the committee's duties and powers. The summary will be added after the meeting.

te: Pre-meeting video · Minutes of Meeting No. 36 approved, subcommittee work, and complaints from the public
Guidelines for conserving and reviving old towns (the Lamphun model), and petitions from Phatthalung and Trang referred to the provincial governors
se: Subcommittees reported on guidelines for conserving and reviving old towns, with information from the Fine Arts Department, the Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning and the founder of Lamphun City Lab; on progress with the seminar on the Licensing Facilitation Act on 20 November 2026; and on observing a water rescue drill on the Mekong River in Nong Khai Province. The meeting agreed to send letters to the Governors of Phatthalung and Trang asking them to check the facts and consider resolving the problems raised in 6 petitions from the Senators Meet the People programme, lower southern group, and to send 2 project proposals from the Ao Tong Subdistrict Administrative Organisation, Trang Province, to the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives and the Committee on Tourism and Sports. It also approved the appointment of 3 advisers.
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: guidelines for conserving and reviving old towns, with the Fine Arts Department, the Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning (ONEP) and Lamphun City Lab (town-planning measures and laws protecting ancient monuments, buffer zones, and the Lamphun model as a case study)
Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): progress on the seminar on the Licensing Facilitation Act, 20 November 2026, 08.00–16.00 hrs, Rama Gardens Hotel
Disaster Subcommittee: the subcommittee chair observed a water rescue drill on the Mekong River, Nong Khai (a tourist-boat accident scenario, with Thai and Lao PDR agencies training together)

Senators-meet-the-people, lower south, 6 matters: the boundary of public land at Thale Noi, Phatthalung (2 matters) / a complaint alleging illegal use of push nets, Ko Sukon Subdistrict / rights to farmland, Ko Sukon Subdistrict / access to the raft landing at Ta Se pier, Hat Samran District, and in Ko Sukon Subdistrict, Palian District / repair of the Ban Laem fishing pier, Ko Sukon Subdistrict, Trang

Senators-meet-the-people: the Chief Executive of the Ao Tong Subdistrict Administrative Organisation, Wang Wiset District, Trang, proposed 2 projects (developing the Roi Chan Phan Wang Waterfall tourist site / a water-storage weir at Ban Wang Hin with a water-distribution system, Village No. 7, Ao Tong Subdistrict)
Appointment of 1 honorary adviser and 2 advisers to the Central and Provincial Subcommittee (effective 12 November 2026)
